description: Patch fields on an existing project. Only the fields you pass in `patch` are touched — omit a field to leave it as is. Pass `null` to clear a nullable field (root_path, icon, color, description). `position` controls the project ordering in the activity-bar switcher (lower = earlier). Cannot change `id`; create a new project and migrate instead.

id.description: Slug of the project to update.

name: iyke_project_update
